text:
```yaml
name: Update Nix Vendor Hash

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - 'vendor/'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-vendor-hash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run helper script to update vendorHash
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/update-vendorhash.sh
          ./scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

      - name: Commit changes if any
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update vendorHash" || true

      - name: Push changes to PR branch
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF
```
